title: Medicare Plan Comparison
description: Given shared utilization assumptions plus Path A (Original Medicare + Medigap + standalone Part D) and Path B (Medicare Advantage) plan parameters, prices both paths for a typical year and a bad-year stress test, applies the Part D out-of-pocket cap and the Advantage MOOP, and returns the annual difference and worst-case ceilings.
data_vintage: 2026 CMS Parts A & B and Part D standard benefit parameters
